name: Resume Tailoring Skill
headline: Resume Tailoring Skill - AI-Powered Resume
short_description: AI-powered resume tailoring skill that researches roles, surfaces undocumented experiences, and creates tailored resumes from your existing resume library. Benefits recruiters and job seekers by automating resume customization for each application.
author: varunr89

sections.overview:
Resume Tailoring Skill automates the creation of customized resumes optimized for specific job descriptions while maintaining factual accuracy. It analyzes job postings and company requirements, then surfaces relevant experiences from your resume library through conversational discovery interviews. The skill generates professional resumes in multiple formats (Markdown, DOCX, PDF) with confidence-scored content matching and transparent gap identification. Process single jobs or batch multiple similar applications efficiently with shared experience discovery. Your library grows with each successful resume, improving future tailoring.
Tailor resumes for multiple similar job openings at once with shared experience discovery
Surface undocumented experiences and accomplishments through guided branching interviews
Generate ATS-friendly resumes optimized for specific job descriptions and company culture
Build a self-improving resume library that captures new experiences from each application
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/varunr89/resume-tailoring-skill`
sections.usage:
```
Tailor my resume for the [JOB_TITLE] role at [COMPANY_NAME]. Use my existing resume content ([RESUME_FILE_NAME]) and research the job description from [JOB_POSTING_URL] or [JOB_DESCRIPTION_TEXT]. Highlight [KEY_SKILLS_OR_EXPERIENCES] that match the role requirements. Create a tailored version that includes undocumented experiences relevant to this position. Format the output as a clean, ATS-friendly resume with [DESIRED_SECTIONS].
```
Copy
